title: Guard spec v1 — baseline
description: Frozen fingerprints of findings that existed when the baseline was taken. A finding whose fingerprint appears here is suppressed up to `count` occurrences; everything else is new and gates. Only non-passing verdicts are ever fingerprinted.

dirty.description: Whether the working tree had uncommitted changes when the evidence behind this baseline was taken.

snapshot.description: When the evidence behind this baseline was a working-tree snapshot: that throwaway commit. `head` is then the parent of the commit that will carry the tests; `baseline --restamp` moves `head` once a clean probe reproduces the same fingerprints.

restampedAt.description: Set when `head` was moved by `baseline --restamp` (same fingerprints, clean tree). `createdAt` keeps the original freeze time.
